g.text: (Un)equal weight: research output compared with disease burden

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: The 16 largest deficits and 8 largest surpluses in study–country pairs

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Base: all 204 national GBD 2023 locations, including zero-study locations; 31,592 unique study–country pairs. Expected pairs = 31,592 × each country’s share of DALYs across

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: these same 204 locations. Hong Kong, Cayman Islands, French Guiana and Guadeloupe have no row in this national GBD export and are excluded. A multi-country study counts once

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: per named country. Studies span 2010–2026; 2026 is incomplete. Burden: GBD 2023 all-cause DALYs. Income colours use July 2026 classifications, combining the three low- and

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #8a8983

g.text: middle-income groups. Proportionality is a reference point, not an adequacy target. Labels are rounded to whole pairs.
